description: This file defines internal interfaces for asynchronous observables and observers used within Orleans streaming, including methods for resuming subscriptions, unsubscribing, retrieving all subscriptions, and cleanup operations.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncObservable`1
classes.description: An internal interface extending async observable functionalities with additional methods for managing subscriptions and cleanup.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncBatchObserver`1
classes.description: An internal interface extending batch producer capabilities with cleanup functionality.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription with a given observer or batch observer, optionally with a token.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a given subscription handle asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles associated with the observable.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the observable or observer.
